# Every codex feature flag `codex features list` reports (removed flags left
# out), each with Watchtower's decision for the codex runs it launches itself
# (batch, chat, code questions, spec review, automation agent()):
#   off  — turned off on every such run (disabledFeatures in generator.go;
#          a read-folder run turns shell_tool back on to read files);
#   batch — off on tool-less batch and image calls only; runs with tools
#          need it (toolRunFeatures);
#   keep — left as the owner's codex configures it.
# Workbench terminal sessions (the owner's own codex) never get these flags.
# TestDisabledFeatures_MatchSnapshot pins disabledFeatures to the "off" lines;
# scripts/check-codex-features.sh compares this file with the installed CLI
# after a codex upgrade (--update adds new flags as "undecided", which fails
# the offline test until each gets a decision).
# Snapshot of codex-cli 0.159.2; codex_hooks is the legacy alias of hooks
# (not listed by the CLI, still accepted).
